activities.activity: Sleeping in on a Saturday morning, fan on for air circulation
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a warm shower
Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, brewing tea
Clearing breakfast dishes, wiping counters and running the dishwasher
Weekend chores: vacuuming floors and tidying the living area
Walking to the local market for the weekly grocery shopping
Unpacking and organising groceries into the refrigerator and cupboards
Cooking a light midday meal on the induction cooker and eating it
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
Afternoon leisure: brisk walk and casual sports at the neighbourhood park
Showering and changing out of sweaty clothes after exercise
Using the computer to review next week's community program schedule and note the new peak electricity hours (16:00-21:00) from Monday
Preparing dinner, chopping vegetables and cooking on the induction cooker while the range hood runs
Eating dinner and cleaning up the table
Relaxing with TV and light reading under the air conditioner
Winding down with the desk lamp on, browsing the phone and reading before bed
Night routine: washing face, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
Sleeping, fan running at low speed for comfort
